text:
Let me analyze this question carefully.

Pete Sampras won 14 Grand Slam titles during his career, all in the 20th century (his last Grand Slam win was the 2002 US Open, but that was in the 21st century - his 14th and final slam).

Looking at his Grand Slam wins in the 20th century:
- Wimbledon: 7 titles (1993-1995, 1997-2000)
- US Open: 5 titles (1990, 1993, 1995-1996, 2002 - but 2002 is 21st century, so 4 in 20th century)
- Australian Open: 2 titles (1994, 1997)
- French Open: 0 titles

Pete Sampras never won the French Open throughout his entire career. He reached the semifinals
